# Look for cylindrical faces (for slider joint axis)
print("\n=== Analyzing faces for potential joint features ===")

def analyze_faces(obj, name):
    print(f"\n{name} faces:")
    for i, face in enumerate(obj.Shape.Faces):
        surface = face.Surface
        print(f"  Face {i}: {type(surface).__name__}")
        if hasattr(surface, 'Radius'):

        if hasattr(surface, 'Axis'):
            print(f"    Axis: {surface.Axis}")
        if hasattr(surface, 'Position'):
            print(f"    Position: {surface.Position}")

analyze_faces(base_obj, "Base")
analyze_faces(gancho_obj, "Gancho")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
EOF
"}
